note: US government tree registers read straight from their ArcGIS layers by scripts/register_import.py (2026-10-06). Facts only: none of these carries an open licence for republishing the dataset, so they feed layer-1 leads and never map dots. Each entry says where it points, what it filters out (hard rule 10) and what not to copy.

sources.name: Cook County FP champions
sources.source_note: Forest Preserves of Cook County champion tree register (government). No licence stated: use the facts for layer 1, never republish the dataset. Circumference assumed inches; check against the DBH field.

sources.name: NPS NCR witness trees
sources.source_note: National Park Service, National Capital Region witness trees (federal; NPS text and NPGallery images are usually public domain, check each image's credit).

sources.name: NPS NCR notable trees
sources.source_note: National Park Service, National Capital Region notable trees storymap layer (federal). Image rights vary per image (Image_UseLimit).

sources.name: Independence MO heritage trees
sources.source_note: City of Independence (MO) heritage trees (government), approved entries on public ground only. The layer carries submitter email and phone fields: NEVER copy them. Facts only.

sources.name: Hawaii DLNR champions, Oahu
sources.source_note: Hawaii DLNR Division of Forestry and Wildlife big tree champions (state government). Facts only.

sources.name: Hawaii DLNR champions, Big Island
sources.source_note: Hawaii DLNR Division of Forestry and Wildlife big tree champions (state government). Facts only.

sources.name: Hawaii DLNR champions, Kauai
sources.source_note: Hawaii DLNR Division of Forestry and Wildlife big tree champions (state government). Facts only.

sources.name: NJDEP big and heritage trees, NYC day trip
sources.source_note: NJDEP Big and Heritage Trees of New Jersey (state government; every row carries the owner's permission to list). Facts only under the NJDEP data distribution agreement. Many stand at home addresses: hard rule 10 applies, a front garden never ships. Real place name and true travel time from Manhattan.

sources.name: NJDEP big and heritage trees, Princeton
sources.source_note: NJDEP Big and Heritage Trees of New Jersey (state government; every row carries the owner's permission to list). Facts only. Many stand at home addresses: hard rule 10 applies.

sources.name: South Carolina champion trees (Clemson)
sources.source_note: South Carolina champion tree database, maintained with Clemson University for the state programme (government). Private-ground rows blocked; rows with no land_type still need an access check. Facts only.

sources.name: Prince George's County native champions
sources.source_note: Prince George's County (MD) native champion trees (government). Several stand in parks (Fort Washington, Bladensburg Dueling Ground); a street address alone may be a home, hard rule 10. Facts only.

sources.name: Ohio DNR champions, Cincinnati
sources.source_note: Ohio Department of Natural Resources champion tree list (state government). The layer carries owner and contact names, phones and emails: NEVER copy them. An address may be a home, hard rule 10. Facts only.

sources.name: Ohio DNR champions, Columbus
sources.source_note: Ohio Department of Natural Resources champion tree list (state government). The layer carries owner and contact names, phones and emails: NEVER copy them. An address may be a home, hard rule 10. Facts only.

sources.name: Norfolk significant trees
sources.source_note: City of Norfolk (VA) significant trees, via its open-data portal and the HRPDC layer (government). Coordinates are published to three decimals (about 100 m), so pins start approximate. Private rows blocked. Facts only; DBH in inches is in the source, not converted here.

sources.name: Tempe treasured trees
sources.source_note: City of Tempe (AZ) Treasured Trees programme (government), with a story link per tree (StoryURL). Facts only; the city's pictures are not ours to republish without a licence.
